armyRule.body:
At the start of your Command phase, you can select one **[gloss:sm-combat-doctrine:combat doctrine]** listed below. If you do, that **combat doctrine** is active for friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES units with this ability until the start of your next Command phase.

### Assault Doctrine
When this unit is selected to make an **[gloss:advance-move:advance move]**, that **advance move** does not prevent this unit from being **[gloss:eligible-to-charge:eligible to declare a charge]**.

### Devastator Doctrine
This unit’s ranged attacks have [ASSAULT].

### Tactical Doctrine
When this unit is selected to make a **[gloss:fall-back-move:fall-back move]**, that **fall-back move** does not prevent this unit from being **[gloss:eligible-to-shoot:eligible to shoot]** and **[gloss:eligible-to-charge:eligible to declare a charge]**.

Unless otherwise stated:
▪ You can only select each **[gloss:sm-combat-doctrine:combat doctrine]** once per battle.
▪ Only one **combat doctrine** can be active for each unit. If a rule makes a **combat doctrine** active for a unit, any **combat doctrine** previously active for that unit is no longer active for that unit.

### Transhuman Strategist
At the start of the battle round, if a model with this ability is your WARLORD, gain 1**[gloss:command-points:CP]**.
armyRule.name: Combat Doctrines

enhancements.body: DEATH COMPANY model only. This model's melee attacks have +2 **[gloss:attack-dice:A]**.
enhancements.flavor: Lost to a memory shard of the Primarch, in this warrior's mind, he has entered the Archtraitor's sanctum, and all that stands between him and Horus is a host of massing traitors.
enhancements.name: On the Archtraitor's Bridge

enhancements.body: DEATH COMPANY model only. When you target this unit with the **[gloss:heroic-intervention:Heroic Intervention stratagem]**, that use is -1 **[gloss:command-points:CP]**.
enhancements.flavor: Proudly is Sanguinius remembered for his rapid intercession in the protection of his gene-sons. Driven on by death visions, this lost warrior is a tragic monument to such glory.
enhancements.name: Instinctive Interception

rule.body:
Friendly DEATH COMPANY units have the following:
▪ At the start of each phase, the **[gloss:sm-combat-doctrine:assault doctrine]** is active for this unit.
▪ The **devastator/tactical doctrine** __cannot__ be active for this unit.

This means that, regardless of any other rules, DEATH COMPANY units can never have an active doctrine other than the **assault doctrine**.

**Restrictions:** Your army can include BLOOD ANGELS units, but it cannot include any ADEPTUS ASTARTES units drawn from any other Chapter.
rule.flavor: Swept up in visions of the Primarch’s blood-drenched final hours, the Lost throw themselves upon the foe, channelling the Great Angel’s fury and striving their utmost to emulate his mastery of close-quarters combat.
rule.name: Sanguinius' Fury

stratagems.effect: Your unit has MOBILE.
stratagems.flavor: Knowing in what remains of his mind that his is a sorrow-filled mission of galactic consequence, this ancient interred warrior permits nothing to stand in his way.
stratagems.name: No Barrier to Retribution
stratagems.when: Your Movement or your Charge phase, when a friendly DEATH COMPANY DREADNOUGHT unit is selected to make a **[gloss:normal-move:normal]/[gloss:advance:advance]/[gloss:charge-move:charge move]**.

stratagems.effect: Your unit can make a **[gloss:surge-move:surge move]** of up to D6".
stratagems.flavor: They may no longer recognise the foe before them, but the Lost Brethren are sane enough to identify an attack and capable of responding with a violent surge and a howl of wrath.
stratagems.name: Rage-fuelled Response
stratagems.when: Your opponent's Shooting phase, when an enemy unit that targeted a friendly **[gloss:unengaged:unengaged]** DEATH COMPANY unit has shot.

stratagems.effect:
That enemy unit is **hated** until the end of the battle:
▪ While a unit is **hated**, friendly DEATH COMPANY units' attacks that target that unit have +1 to **[gloss:wound-roll:wound rolls]**.
stratagems.flavor: With their perceptions twisted, the battle-brothers of the Death Company transmute loss into the worst of ancient betrayals and seek only to sever such treachery from existence.
stratagems.name: Death Begets Vengeance
stratagems.when: Any phase, when a friendly DEATH COMPANY unit is **[gloss:destroyed:destroyed]** by an enemy unit.

enhancements.body:
ADEPTUS ASTARTES JUMP PACK model only. When this unit is **[gloss:selected-to-fight:selected to fight]**, this unit's melee attacks have:
▪ [LETHAL HITS].
▪ __Or:__ [SUSTAINED HITS 1]
enhancements.flavor: This deadly duellist leads his battle-brothers in masterful strikes capable of carving through their armoured or swarming foes with breathtaking fluidity.
enhancements.name: Angelic Executioner

enhancements.body: ADEPTUS ASTARTES JUMP PACK model only. (once per battle, per army) When this unit is **[gloss:selected-to-fight:selected to fight]** you can use this ability. If you do, this model's melee attacks have +1 **[gloss:damage-roll:D]**.
enhancements.flavor: Granted a glimmer of foresight by his genetic inheritance, this Son of Sanguinius has identified a foe whose future is drenched in the blood of the Imperium. Such an enemy cannot be allowed to live.
enhancements.name: Shadow of Abomination

rule.body:
The **[gloss:sm-combat-doctrine:tactical doctrine]** is active for SANGUINARY GUARD units __in addition__ to any other **combat doctrine**.

**Restrictions:** Your army can include BLOOD ANGELS units, but it cannot include any ADEPTUS ASTARTES units drawn from any other Chapter.
rule.flavor: Few living warriors embody the ideal of the Emperor's wrathful angels more than the Sanguinary Guard, for they appear without warning to wreak death and destruction before surging on to the next foe with shocking speed.
rule.name: Wrath of Angels

stratagems.effect:
Select one enemy unit **[gloss:engaged:engaged]** with your unit. Roll one D6 for each model in your unit **engaged** with that enemy unit:
▪ For each 3+, that enemy unit suffers 1 **[gloss:mortal-wound:mortal wound]**.
stratagems.flavor: The meteoric impact of the Sanguinary Guard is an unavoidable judgement on those who have incurred the Chapter's wrath.
stratagems.name: Judgement of the Golden Host
stratagems.when: Your Charge phase, when a friendly SANGUINARY GUARD unit form your army ends a **[gloss:charge-move:charge move]**.

stratagems.effect: Your unit can make a **[gloss:normal-move:normal move]** of up to D3+3".
stratagems.flavor: Ever reaching for the heights of exemplary valour instilled in their forebears by Sanguinius, the golden host seize every opportunity to claim positions from which to strike anew.
stratagems.name: Inexorable Valour
stratagems.when: Your opponent's Movement phase, when an enemy unit that was **[gloss:engaged:engaged]** with a friendly SANGUINARY GUARD unit ends a **[gloss:fall-back-move:fall-back move]**, if that SANGUINARY GUARD unit is **[gloss:unengaged:unengaged]**.

stratagems.effect:
Your unit has:
▪ [core:Stealth].
▪ -3" **[gloss:detection-range:detection range]**.
stratagems.flavor: When they power forward in rapid leaps, the glare emitted by their jump packs' nacelles reflecting from the mirrored gleam of their armour, the Sanguinary Guard seem to glow with a blinding radiance few can look upon.
stratagems.name: Blinding Blurs of Vengeance
stratagems.when: Your opponent's Shooting phase, when an enemy unit targets a friendly SANGUINARY GUARD unit.

enhancements.body: ADEPTUS ASTARTES model only. This unit has [core:Scouts 6”].
enhancements.flavor: A flash of foresight and clarity sings through this warrior’s blood and guides his steps into battle.
enhancements.name: Prescient Flash

enhancements.body: ADEPTUS ASTARTES model only. Enemy units cannot target this unit with **[gloss:snap-shooting:snap shooting]** attacks.
enhancements.flavor: What was before merely a decorative blood drop pendant now shines with a seemingly miraculous light as bright as any star. The foe are forced to avert their gaze from its wrathful magnificence.
enhancements.name: Blazing Icon

enhancements.body:
ADEPTUS ASTARTES model only. (Once per battle, per army) At the end of a phase in which this model is **[gloss:destroyed:destroyed]**, roll one D6:
▪ On a 2+, set this model back up on the battlefield as close as possible to where it was **destroyed**, **[gloss:unengaged:unengaged]**, with 3 wounds remaining.
enhancements.flavor: Knowing only too well the desperate and vital nature of the battle before him, this scion of Sanguinius echoes his Primarch’s resolute determination to fight on even beyond what seems the doors of certain death.
enhancements.name: Ordained Sacrifice

enhancements.body:
ADEPTUS ASTARTES model only. (Once per battle, per army) In your Command phase you can use this ability. If you do, until the end of the turn this unit can:
▪ Re-roll **[gloss:advance-roll:advance rolls]**.
▪ Re-roll **[gloss:charge-roll:charge rolls]**.
enhancements.flavor: Just as his Primarch before him, this warrior has foreseen his impending doom and goes towards it regardless, desperate to land a telling blow upon the foe before death claims him.
enhancements.name: Unto Death

rule.body:
Friendly BLOOD ANGELS CHARACTER units:
▪ Can re-roll **[gloss:hit-roll:hit rolls]** of 1.
▪ Can re-roll **[gloss:wound-roll:wound rolls]** of 1.

**Restrictions:** Your army can include BLOOD ANGELS units, but it cannot include any ADEPTUS ASTARTES units drawn from any other Chapter.
rule.flavor: Never do the Blood Angels stand taller or strive harder than when faced with seemingly impossible odds. At such times, the Sons of Sanguinius delve deep into their souls for preternatural reserves of determination, fury and focus. Sometimes, they even touch upon the uncertain gift of prophecy that was said to be their gene‑sire’s boon and his curse.
rule.name: Legacy of the Angel

stratagems.effect:
Your unit’s melee attacks:
▪ Have [LETHAL HITS].
▪ __Or:__ If your unit is a CHARACTER unit, have [LETHAL HITS], [LANCE].
stratagems.flavor: Keeping the beast within under tight control, the Blood Angels nonetheless tap into that inner rage and shackle it to their precisely aimed blows.
stratagems.name: Focused Fury
stratagems.when: Fight phase, when a friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit is **[gloss:selected-to-fight:selected to fight]**.

stratagems.effect: Your unit has CHARACTER until the start of your next Command phase.
stratagems.flavor: In this most desperate moment of need, a lone battle‑brother rises to the challenge as a true inheritor of the Angel’s legacy.
stratagems.name: Instant of Grace
stratagems.target: One friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES INFANTRY unit.
stratagems.when: Your Command phase.

stratagems.effect: Place your unit in **[gloss:strategic-reserves:strategic reserves]**.
stratagems.flavor: In the face of encroaching doom, as the world seems to burn around them, these scions of Sanguinius leap high into the tormented heavens, ready to strike down with vengeful fury upon the enemy teeming below.
stratagems.name: Unto the Burning Skies
stratagems.target: One friendly THE SANGUINOR/**[gloss:unengaged:unengaged]** ADEPTUS ASTARTES JUMP PACK unit.
stratagems.when: End of your opponent’s Fight phase.

stratagems.effect:
Your unit has:
▪ [core:Stealth].
▪ -3" **[gloss:detection-range:detection range]**.
stratagems.flavor: The enemy are engulfed in a soul‑deep shadow for just a moment, as though mighty wings have spread above them and marred their vision with occluding darkness.
stratagems.name: In the Shadow of Great Wings
stratagems.when: Your opponent's Shooting phase, when an enemy unit targets a friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES CHARACTER unit.

stratagems.effect: Your unit’s ranged attacks have [SUSTAINED HITS 1].
stratagems.flavor: Knowing instinctively that the pivotal moment has arrived, these battle‑brothers aim and hammer their foes with unrelenting volleys.
stratagems.name: Strike Now for Glory
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase when a friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit is selected to attack.

stratagems.effect: Select one **[gloss:sm-combat-doctrine:combat doctrine]**. That **combat doctrine** is active for your unit until the start of your next Command phase.
stratagems.flavor: Stern and level-headed, this Blood Angels commander is a beacon of composure amidst the tempest of his brothers’ fury, providing much-needed tactical guidance for his impetuous battle-brothers.
stratagems.name: Measured Strategist
stratagems.target: One friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES CHARACTER unit.
stratagems.when: Your Command phase.
